title: Imperial bedroom
goal: A reader must be able to verify a tightly planned bedroom measuring exactly seven by nine feet.

rubric.must: The exterior dimension strings visibly read 7'0" and 9'0".
A bed and wardrobe are both visible inside the labeled bedroom.
The inward door swing is clear of the bed and wardrobe.
A window is visibly centered on the wall opposite the entry door.
Visible clear floor space permits access from the door to the bed and wardrobe.

ideal.notes: Drafted by Codex from the source, the rubric and the floorplan exemplar, without seeing the engine's own output.

review.evidence: The drawing clearly communicates an exactly 7'0" by 9'0" bedroom, with both required furniture pieces, a centered north-wall window opposite the south entry, and usable circulation around the inward-swinging door.

items.evidence: Exterior dimension strings visibly read 7'0" horizontally and 9'0" vertically.
A single bed and a labeled WARDROBE are both visibly placed inside the labeled BEDROOM.
The south-wall entry door swings inward into open floor area without intersecting the bed or wardrobe.
A 3-foot-wide window is visibly centered along the north wall, opposite the entry door.
Clear central floor space provides an unobstructed route from the entry to both the bed and wardrobe.
